entities.summary: The Kokel Culture is a post-Xiongnu culture, from Southern Siberia, in what is now the modern-day Tuva Republic. This culture is located temporally in the interval between the fall of the Xiongnu Empire and the rise of the First Turkic Khaganate. In Russian archaeology, it is considered as belonging to the "Hunno-Sarmatian period".
